prompt.description: Prompt describing the target shot; reference inputs by tag in connection order, e.g. <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>.

ref_images.description: Up to 9 reference images as base64 data URLs (identity, style, pose).

ref_videos.description: Up to 3 reference video clips as base64 data URLs (motion, camera, editing).

ref_video_audios.description: Audio track paired with each reference video (index-aligned with ref_videos).

ref_audios.description: Up to 3 standalone reference audio clips (e.g. voice).

width.description: Frame width in pixels (must be multiple of 16). Turbo LoRA trained at 544p.

height.description: Frame height in pixels (must be multiple of 16). Turbo LoRA trained at 544p.
